_meta.note: Platform labelling behaviour as researched Oct 2026. Each entry carries confidence + last_verified; re-verify quarterly. Used by rules/engine.py platform_preview().

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.label_on_edit: Edits with AI tools surface the same 'AI info' label; label text does not distinguish generated vs edited.
platforms.removal_policy: Label can be appealed but not removed by the uploader when derived from C2PA/IPTC.
platforms.notes: Auto-applies Content Credentials labels when a C2PA manifest with an AI digital source type is present (rollout confirmed at Google I/O 2026 coverage). Self-disclosure toggle in composer.

platforms.name: Facebook (feed + ads)
platforms.label_on_edit: Same label; ads auto-detected from 1 Jun 2026.
platforms.removal_policy: Appeal via support; cannot opt out when C2PA/IPTC-derived.
platforms.notes: Ads: automated AI-content detection for ad creatives from 1 Jun 2026; political/social-issue ads must disclose digitally altered media.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.label_on_edit: Only 'significant photorealistic' alterations trigger auto-label; beauty filters and colour grading do not.
platforms.removal_policy: Appeal in YouTube Studio; label is permanent for Veo / Dream Screen / C2PA-declared content.
platforms.notes: Since 27 May 2026: auto-labels significant photorealistic AI via internal signals + SynthID + C2PA; label shown below the player (and in expanded description); creators must self-disclose realistic synthetic content at upload.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.label_on_edit: Content made with TikTok AI effects is labelled automatically.
platforms.removal_policy: Cannot be removed when C2PA-derived; self-labels can be edited before posting.
platforms.notes: First major platform to read C2PA Content Credentials for auto-labelling (2024); also attaches Content Credentials to downloads of TikTok AI content.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.label_on_edit: Icon shows for any valid manifest; the popover lists AI generation if declared.
platforms.removal_policy: Not removable; derived from the embedded manifest.
platforms.notes: Shows the CR pin for images with valid C2PA manifests; no independent AI classifier announced.

platforms.name: X (Twitter)
platforms.label_on_edit: Policy-based (synthetic & manipulated media policy); no C2PA reading in production.
platforms.monetization_impact: possible reach reduction when labelled as misleading
platforms.notes: X strips most metadata (including C2PA) on upload; Grok-generated images carry no C2PA.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.label_on_edit: Edited and generated both labelled 'AI modified'.
platforms.monetization_impact: users can tune down AI content in feed (reach impact)
platforms.notes: Labels since Apr 2025 using metadata + classifiers; 'see fewer' control per category.

platforms.name: Google Search / Images (About this image)
platforms.label_text: About this image: 'Made with Google AI' / 'Edited with AI' / Content Credentials
platforms.label_on_edit: Distinguishes generated vs edited only when the manifest/IPTC says so.
platforms.notes: Since I/O 2026 SynthID + C2PA surfaces inside Search, Chrome and Gemini.

platforms.name: Amazon KDP
platforms.label_text: No public label; mandatory disclosure in publishing form
platforms.label_on_edit: AI-assisted (editing) need not be disclosed; AI-generated text/images/translations must be.
